what: Cawood & Mashola 2023 Table 5 was mis-extracted in SUBPHASE_r441 and in every manuscript draft to r445. Corrected here from the publisher's own HTML galley.
source_read: https://sajp.co.za/index.php/sajp/article/view/1926/3461 (AOSIS HTML galley, S Afr J Physiother 2023;79(1):1926, PMID 38059056). Corroborated within the same galley by the abstract and by the Results prose.
results_prose_verbatim: Gastrocnemius muscle tone was not significantly related to the knee angles during any of the stages of the stance phase - initial contact (p = 0.22), loading response (p = 0.45), midstance (p = 0.24), terminal (p = 0.48) or pre-swing (p = 0.85). / we found significant relationships between tibialis anterior muscle tone and knee angles during all stages of the stance phase of gait, except the loading response and midstance

WHAT_WAS_WRONG.diagnosis: the recorded values match NEITHER tone column. The original JATS-XML extraction mis-mapped columns. This was our own extraction error, not a bad agent summary.

THREE_CONSEQUENCES_ALL_AGAINST_THIS_PROJ: Cawood is NOT a null at initial contact. Tibialis anterior tone is significant there (p=0.019).

GASTROCNEMIUS tone -- the muscle class this project lesions -- is not significantly related to knee angle at ANY stance phase. That is the comparison relevant to the spastic arm, and in patients it is a null. The model's central dose prediction is unsupported by the one dataset that measured it.
The charge that Cawood's abstract and Table 5 contradict each other IS FALSE and is withdrawn. Abstract, Results prose and Table 5 all agree. The contradiction was manufactured by our mis-extraction.
SUPERSEDES: SUBPHASE_r441.json /cawood_table5_plantarflexor_tone_vs_knee and its /AGREEMENT field. There is no 'Cawood strongest window' for plantarflexor tone to compare the model against: no gastrocnemius window is significant.
MODEL_SIDE_UNCHANGED: The model's own sub-phase numbers in SUBPHASE_r441.json were computed from .sto files and are unaffected. Only the patient-side comparison changes.
caveats_on_the_null: only 9 of 12 had any gastrocnemius tone
authors present the study as underpowered
